items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: Is that the same George Moret who hired you off Governor Nichol Street for your first job?

ctx.x: One of the best sharp play we had in New Orleans. He used to hit a high note in a parade because he had way up above. He was Carlos Tower. Talk about that? Yes, indeed.
Is that the same George Moret who hired you off Governor Nichol Street for your first job?

Yes. Yes. And another man, Oscar Duconge, D-U-C-O-N-G-E is the way I have his spell. Duconge? Duconge. Duconge. Yes. Duconge. Yes. What kind of a band did he have? Well, he had a good affair band. What did he play? Duconge used to play, let me see, I can't remember that. Cornet. Cornet. The brass band wasn't it? Yes. When you had your own band, when you were the leader, what name did you call that? If you were the leader of the band, when did you, in the old days, did you have a name for the band? No, I know.
